find:
quitBtn.textContent = atOutcome
      ? 'Main Menu'
      : s === 'paused' && statusData?.kind === 'practice'
        ? 'End Practice'
        : s === 'paused' && statusData?.kind === 'versus'
          ? 'Main Menu'
          : 'Quit to Title';
why: Collapses the per-state wording, so a match that is already over invites the player to "Quit" it. Issue #323 asks every outcome label to describe exactly what it preserves or replaces, and there is nothing left to abandon on an end screen -- on an intermediate clear the run is preserved besides, which is why this wording was already special-cased there before #323 widened it. The button still appears and still works, so only the copy assertions can see this. RE-ANCHORED by issue #323's contextual pause exit: the single-line ternary this replaced is now a three-arm chain, and collapsing the whole chain is still the same mutation -- every screen, ended or paused, invited to "Quit". It now flattens the practice pause wording as well, which is why the two pause-exit killers joined the list. Re-anchored for issue #261, which added the versus arm to the same ternary.
